meta.title: Approve the onboarding response and send for approval

args.goal: On the prospect's Onboarding Details in the evaluation stage, click Approve; in the Send for Approval tab fill the Buyer Added Attributes form if shown and click Next; on the Vendor/Prospect summary add a Category and Location and click Next; add remarks, continue through the approval workflow, and stop when the screen shows that the prospect has been sent for approval.

steps.note: Performs the complete buyer-side onboarding approval workflow that has no dedicated catalog step.

args.text: The prospect has been sent for Approval

steps.note: Verifies the expected confirmation that the prospect was sent for approval.
